description: MAX7219 LED matrix display, bit-bang SPI, FC16 4-module 32x8px layout

set.description: Render a value on the LED matrix. Numbers are compacted to fit 5 chars; strings are truncated at 5 chars.

value.description: Value to display. Negative numbers → '----'. Numbers ≥100000 are compacted (100k / 1.0M / 99M / 999M / 1B).
